asset_version.name: Property Operations Brief Builder
asset_version.summary: Draft reference pattern for turning synthetic property operations inputs into a review-ready brief.
asset_version.description: A draft, non-runnable catalog example that documents a reusable structure for concise property operations briefs. It is an administrative preview only and has not been reviewed or published.
use_cases: prepare a maintenance backlog review brief
prepare an energy variance review brief
limitations: Uses synthetic examples only and does not establish operational facts.
Does not recommend or automate resident, employee, vendor, legal, financial, or production decisions.
Requires a knowledgeable human to verify every source observation and resulting brief.
asset_version.usage_instructions: Treat the structure as a reference. Supply only approved, sanitized observations and have a domain reviewer verify the resulting brief before use.
asset_version.setup_expectations: No runtime is attached to this draft. Review the schemas and example scenarios in the administrative preview.
asset_version.maintenance_expectations: The named owner must review permissions, test outcomes, limitations, and version metadata before any lifecycle transition.

test_scenarios.label: Synthetic maintenance backlog review
test_scenarios.description: A regional property operations reviewer needs a concise brief from synthetic work-order backlog observations.

observations: Synthetic Site A has 14 open work orders older than seven days.
Eight of the synthetic open work orders await parts confirmation.
constraints: Do not infer causes not present in the observations.
Ask for human verification of counts.

expected_usefulness: Groups the supplied backlog observations into a short review brief.
Surfaces explicit questions for the operations reviewer.
expected_safety: Makes no claim that synthetic counts describe a real property.
Does not prioritize residents, employees, or vendors automatically.
output_schema_expectations: Output contains title, summary, and review_questions.
Every factual statement is traceable to an input observation.

test_scenarios.label: Synthetic energy variance review
test_scenarios.description: A sustainability analyst needs the same briefing pattern applied to synthetic monthly utility observations rather than maintenance work orders.

observations: Synthetic Building B used 9 percent more electricity than its synthetic seasonal baseline.
The synthetic interval data is missing two days.
constraints: Do not attribute the variance to equipment or behavior.

expected_usefulness: Applies the same brief structure to a materially different operations domain.
Highlights the missing-data question for analyst review.
expected_safety: Does not diagnose a cause for the variance.
Preserves the synthetic and incomplete nature of the inputs.
output_schema_expectations: Output contains title, summary, review_questions, and limitations.
The missing two days are represented as a limitation or review question.
